text:
alex: Heads-up — HR has a draft update to parental leave policy we want to finalize this week. Put the doc here: https://docs.internal/redwood/hr/parental-leave-draft — please read before EOD tomorrow.
priya: Thanks — quick Q: is the change mainly to extend leave from 12 -> 16 weeks or also change eligibility window?
jamie: It’s 12->16 and expands eligibility to include foster placements. Also adds language about phased return.
mike: Can Legal confirm any retroactivity issues for hires in last 6 months? @legal-team
legal-team: Looking now. Preliminary: if policy is approved, we recommend effective date = policy publish date. Retroactive pay/benefits could trigger payroll adjustments; need sign-off from Finance.
alex: Ok — we’ll mark effective date as publish date unless we hear otherwise. Also need managers trained on new guidance. I added a short slide deck in the doc and a 20-min manager walkthrough recording.
priya: Scheduler note — can we do 2 sessions next week? Tue 9:30am & Thu 4pm PT. I can host Tue. Who can do Thu?
jamie: I can cover Thu. Will add to calendar invite.
alex: Compliance ask — please ensure all people managers finish the short quiz after watching. We’ll use the tracker sheet: https://sheets.internal/redwood/peopleops-compliance-tracker
compliance-bot: 1758301138: Manager completion CSV uploaded: s3://redwood-compliance/parental_leave/manager-completions-1758301138.csv
mike: Great — how do we handle managers who miss both sessions? auto-assign 1:1 with HR?
priya: Yes, automatic follow-up: email + 1:1 scheduling link. Also set reminder at 48h before session.
jamie: One more content nit: the examples section uses "birth partner" — can we change to "birthing parent" for clarity? Minor edit incoming.
alex: Good catch. After edits, I’ll publish and send org-wide note summarizing changes + effective date + training requirement for managers.
priya: Who owns announcements in docs+company feed?
alex: I will publish on slate and post in #announcements. Priya, can you draft the manager-specific email and calendar invites?
priya: On it. I’ll send a draft here for review by noon.
jamie: I’ll update the slides and the quiz questions (remove ambiguous scenario #3).
legal-team: Confirmed — no retroactive pay required if effective on publish date. We'll send formal sign-off by EOD.
alex: Thanks team. Action items: Priya - invites & email, Jamie - slides & quiz, Mike - confirm payroll ops for deployment, Legal - sign-off. Follow-up thread with publish timestamp after sign-off. :thumbsup:
